# The Infinite Game of Poetry: Protocols for Living, Listening, and Transcending the Rules

![Marvin Bell](https://www.robertpeake.com/files/2014/03/marvin.png)

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fKqNSE9NmGU&rel=0>

Taking up the idea of protocols as engineered arguments, this talk explores the timeless algorithms that give poetry its power to evolve—from an ancient mnemonic device to a transformational way of being. Drawing on both theory and practice, in this one-hour exploration we will look at various examples of poetry’s rule-making and rule-breaking, and even dabble in a bit of writing as well. In a world at odds with Rilke’s admonition to, “live in the question” never more have we needed what poetry offers according to Marvin Bell: “the least imposition on silence in a world of chatter.” Bring a pen and an inquisitive mind. No prior experience beyond the human experience required.

The Infinite Game of Poetry: Protocols for Living, Listening, and Transcending the Rules

Taking up the idea of protocols as engineered arguments, this talk explores the timeless algorithms that give poetry its power to evolve—from an ancient mnemonic device to a transformational way of being. Drawing on both theory and practice, in this one-hour exploration we will look at various examples of poetry’s rule-making and rule-breaking, and even dabble in a bit of writing as well. In a world at odds with Rilke’s admonition to, “live in the question” never more have we needed what poetry offers according to Marvin Bell: “the least imposition on silence in a world of chatter.” Bring a pen and an inquisitive mind. No prior experience beyond the human experience required.
